info.name: IGDB API - Test Suite - VoDangKhoa
info.description:
This collection is a structured test suite for validating the IGDB API across multiple endpoints, with a focus on functional correctness, data consistency, filtering behavior, response structure, and basic performance checks.

It includes organized test cases for resources such as games, genres, platforms, companies, characters, languages, player perspectives, popularity primitives, collections, reports, and search. The requests cover common validation scenarios including response schema checks, field optionality, enum verification, filtering, search behavior, cross-endpoint data checks, and repeated consistency testing.

The collection also contains performance-oriented scenarios such as cold vs. warm requests, complex query timing, search performance, stress runs, and large payload checks. Overall, it serves as a practical QA and exploratory testing suite for assessing both data quality and response behavior of the IGDB API.
